name: fix_dockerfile_security_hardening
description: Hardens an insecure Dockerfile: pins the base image, drops a baked-in secret, adds a non-root USER and a HEALTHCHECK
prompts: The Dockerfile has several production hardening problems. Fix them without changing what the app does: (1) pin the base image to a specific version instead of `node:latest` (e.g. node:20-bookworm-slim); (2) remove the hardcoded `ENV API_KEY=...` secret entirely - secrets must be injected at runtime, never baked into the image; (3) create and switch to a non-root user with a `USER` instruction before the CMD so the container does not run as root; (4) add a `HEALTHCHECK` that requests http://localhost:3000/health. Keep the WORKDIR, the npm install, the COPY steps, `ENV NODE_ENV=production`, `EXPOSE 3000`, and the existing CMD.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:latest

WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .

ENV API_KEY=sk-live-abc123secret
ENV NODE_ENV=production

EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

test_setup_files.test_dockerfile.py:
import re

text = open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8').read()
low = text.lower()

from_m = re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*FROM\s+(\S+)', text)
assert from_m, 'no FROM instruction'
base = from_m.group(1)
assert ':' in base or '@sha256' in base, f'base image is not pinned to a version: {base!r}'
assert not base.lower().endswith(':latest'), f'base image must be pinned, not :latest ({base!r})'

assert 'sk-live-abc123secret' not in text, 'the hardcoded API_KEY secret is still baked into the image'
assert not re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*ENV\s+API_KEY', text), 'API_KEY must not be set via ENV in the image'

users = re.findall(r'(?mi)^\s*USER\s+(\S+)', text)
assert users, 'no USER instruction - the container still runs as root'
assert users[-1].lower() not in ('root', '0'), f'the final USER must not be root: {users[-1]!r}'

assert re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*HEALTHCHECK', text), 'no HEALTHCHECK instruction'
assert 'health' in low, 'the HEALTHCHECK should probe the /health endpoint'

# behavior preserved
assert re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*ENV\s+NODE_ENV\s*=?\s*production', text) or 'node_env=production' in low.replace(' ', ''), 'ENV NODE_ENV=production was dropped'
assert re.search(r'(?mi)^\s*EXPOSE\s+3000', text), 'EXPOSE 3000 was dropped'
assert 'server.js' in text, 'the CMD was changed'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-bookworm-slim

WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .

ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Secret is injected at runtime (e.g. -e API_KEY=...), never baked in.

RUN useradd --system --create-home appuser
USER appuser

EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
